findings.suggested_fix: Confirm the verifier profile provides Postgres, or record the executed and skipped test counts for patients-last-visit.test.ts in the verification evidence.
findings.text: The new API regression tests for REQ-2/4/5/6/7/13 sit in describe.skipIf(!pgAvailable()), and checks.json only records that the test step passed. Nothing shows these tests actually ran rather than being skipped.

rubric_items.reason: Both changed components match the design: a COMPLETED max(starts_at) subquery in PatientRepo with paging and sort untouched, and a Last visit column using startsAt with a '-' fallback. The deviation from optional to always-present nullable is now recorded (prior F-2 resolved).
The SQL stays in api/src/repositories, the list envelope and 20 per page are unchanged, instants stay UTC and are formatted in the hospital zone, and no logging is added.
7 files, +127/-4. Three are source, and the rest are the regression tests F-1 asked for plus the pinned-key and fixture updates the type change requires. No unrelated edits.

Null maps to '-', and tests now cover the status filter, latest-of-two, the '-' fallback and the Kolkata date boundary (prior F-1 resolved). The API tests skip when Postgres is unavailable, so the passing verifier run may not have exercised them.
The summary and per-file changes match the code and test names. The open-question evidence now points to split.md L74 and L80 (prior F-3 resolved).
